adjustmentsFromBrief: Scope reduced to the 8 Mac boards per the 2026-11-16 Mac-first decision; mobile boards removed from the canvas.
Sidebar footer shows service and Agent API status instead of iPhone/iPad connection.
Settings drops Tailscale and device pairing (phase 2) and adds 備份／還原 (phase-1 production-ready requirement).
Conflict board reframed for phase 1: this window's edits vs a version an external editor wrote to disk.
Added onAccent token: dark accent #8EA2FF is light, so primary-button text must be dark (#161615, 7.56:1) instead of white.
Added scrim token per theme for dialogs.
Diffs use strikethrough/underline as well as color, so deletions and insertions do not rely on red/green hue alone.
Partial adoption is per-change checkboxes (DESIGN.md requires 採用／部分採用／捨棄); the brief listed only 採用／插入／重試／捨棄.
Restoring a revision or undoing an AI change creates a new revision instead of rewriting history.
Platform simulations use fixed neutral platform-like backgrounds, not the app theme.
keyboard: Visible focus ring on every control (2px accent, 2px offset).

Shortcuts declared with aria-keyshortcuts: ⌘F search, ⌘N new, ⌘/ visual/source, ⌘P preview, ⌘↩ adopt and esc discard inside the AI panel, ⌘Z undo. Only the AI panel keys are wired in the prototype (scoped onKeyDown; the canvas forbids global key handlers).
Text inputs that act on Enter ignore Enter while an IME is composing.

storage: Image post and video works stay Markdown-first: library/works/<id>/source.md with YAML front matter (type, title, images: ordered relative paths, cover: path or {time_seconds}, video: path, tags); the body is the plain-text description. Media live in the work's assets/ folder as files. Revisions snapshot source.md; every write carries base_revision / If-Match and returns 409 on a stale base.
External (mounted) folders keep the same front matter in the user's .md; media are referenced in place, never moved.
Per-platform copy reuses PlatformVariant (title, body, tags, cover_asset_id) plus an 'inherit' flag so a variant can follow the shared copy.
api: POST /api/v1/works {type: article|image|video, title?} — create by type.

PATCH /api/v1/works/:id {base_revision, title?, description?, tags?, images?: asset_id[] (full ordered list), cover?: {asset_id}|{time_seconds}, video_asset_id?} — one atomic, revisioned write; 409 on stale base.
GET /api/v1/works list items gain thumbnail {asset_id, kind, time_seconds?}, image_count, duration_seconds, orientation.
Cover frame: recommended client-side capture from the <video> element, uploaded as a normal image asset (no ffmpeg); alternative GET /api/v1/assets/:id/frame?t= needs ffmpeg in the server bundle.
PATCH /api/v1/works/:id/variants/:platform gains images?, cover?, inherit?.
Video understanding reuses the QC-023 AI job + estimate endpoints with the work's video asset; adopting a suggestion is a normal PATCH that creates an ai_accepted revision.
Missing media: list responses mark image/video refs as missing (existing MediaRef status) so the editor can show 檔案遺失.
Tabs are client-only (app preferences: ordered work ids, active id, per-tab mode); restore uses GET /api/v1/works?ids=… to fetch titles/state in one call.

openQuestions.q: 貼圖與視頻作品怎麼存？
openQuestions.recommend: Markdown＋front matter：Finder 可讀，沿用現有 revision、409 與外部掛載。

openQuestions.q: 視頻封面幀從哪裡來？
options: App 從播放器截圖後上傳成素材
服務端用 ffmpeg 擷取
openQuestions.recommend: App 截圖：不必把 ffmpeg 打包進服務，也避開授權問題。

openQuestions.q: 公眾號貼圖張數上限？
openQuestions.recommend: 暫用 20 只提示，確認後寫進 PLATFORM_LIMITS。

openQuestions.q: 視頻平台文案怎麼分？
options: 共用文案＋各平台可覆寫
openQuestions.recommend: 共用＋覆寫：多數時候只寫一次，視頻號標題 16 字再單獨改短。

openQuestions.q: 長視頻（超過 1 小時）預設怎麼分析？
openQuestions.recommend: 低解析度全片：較便宜，且不漏掉後段。

openQuestions.q: 分頁數量要不要設上限？
options: 不設上限，溢出時捲動加全部分頁選單
openQuestions.recommend: 不設上限：自動關閉可能關掉還在用的作品。

openQuestions.q: 關閉未存分頁的選項？
options: 重試儲存／不儲存並關閉／取消
openQuestions.recommend: 重試儲存：內容本來會自動儲存，未存只會出現在寫入失敗時。

openQuestions.q: 重開 App 時恢復分頁的方式？
options: 全部恢復，只載入作用中的分頁
openQuestions.recommend: 全部恢復、延後載入：開得快，分頁也都在。

openQuestions.q: 英文介面裡的平台名稱？
openQuestions.recommend: 短名：計數列放得下；平台預覽內照平台原樣不翻譯。

openQuestions.q: 既有的混合類型作品怎麼顯示？

decisions.視頻封面幀從哪裡來？: App 從播放器截圖後上傳成素材（推薦），不打包 ffmpeg。
decisions.公眾號貼圖張數上限？: 暫用 20，只提示不阻擋，寫進 PLATFORM_LIMITS 並標 reference。
decisions.視頻平台文案怎麼分？: 共用＋各平台可覆寫（推薦）。
decisions.長視頻（超過 1 小時）預設怎麼分析？: 低解析度全片（推薦）；仍須先顯示預估費用，使用者確認才送出。
decisions.分頁數量要不要設上限？: 不設上限（推薦）。另加：同時保持載入的編輯器最多 8 個，其餘分頁卸載成未載入狀態，草稿與游標先存起來，點選時再載入。

decisions.重開 App 時恢復分頁的方式？: 全部恢復、只載入作用中的分頁（推薦）。
decisions.英文介面裡的平台名稱？: 用短名，但小紅書用 RedNote（不用 RED）：RedNote／WeChat OA／Douyin／Channels；平台預覽內照平台原樣。
decisions.既有的混合類型作品怎麼顯示？: 保留「混合」標籤，只出現在「全部」（推薦）。

decisions: AI 服務分成四個分頁（供應商、用途、用量、隱私），不是卡片提議的五段長頁：使用者明確不要長捲動；「隱私」與「僅本地模型」放在一起，用量與提醒金額獨立一頁。
供應商用「清單＋詳情」雙欄，不用點進去再返回：測試連線時左側列的狀態同步變化，一眼看到其他供應商；窄視窗才改為上下排列。
模型選擇只放在供應商詳情；「用途」頁只選預設供應商，模型跟著該供應商設定：同一個模型不在兩處設定。視頻理解目前只有 Gemini，列鎖定。
撤回告知只在供應商詳情；「隱私」頁列出每家內容送往哪裡與確認狀態，用「管理」跳到詳情，避免兩處操作同一件事。
測試連線結果用卡片呈現原因＋下一步（金鑰無效→更換金鑰；連不上→重試／檢查 Base URL；額度不足→重試），技術詳情單獨一列可複製，不含金鑰。
少文字：每頁不放副標；只保留做決定時需要的頁尾說明（服務常駐、只備份資料庫、金鑰只在鑰匙圈、估算以帳單為準、只在按下時送出）。

api: POST /api/v1/ai/providers/:provider/test (owner) → { ok, latency_ms, model_count, tested_at, error?: { code: invalid_key | unreachable | quota_exhausted | rate_limited | bad_response, http_status?, detail } }. Probe the free list-models endpoint (Gemini GET /v1beta/models, Anthropic GET /v1/models, OpenAI GET /v1/models, New API GET {base_url}/models), 10 s timeout, Keychain key never leaves the Mac or reaches logs; sent only when the user presses 測試連線. Fake services in tests.
Map 429 by provider error code: insufficient_quota / RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED → quota_exhausted (額度不足); plain rate limit → rate_limited (shown as 暫時受限，稍後重試, not drawn).
Provider settings response gains last_test { status, at, latency_ms, model_count } so the list shows 連線正常 · 2 分鐘前 after restart; and base_url_host for New API so 隱私 can say where content goes.
Model list: generalise QC-054 GET /api/v1/ai/providers/:provider/models to every provider (known list as fallback, refresh=1); the test call can fill the same cache.
Defaults per task: GET/PUT /api/v1/ai/defaults { rewrite, title, video } (provider ids; video must be gemini). Absent → current behaviour (AI 工作台 picks).
Usage: existing GET /api/v1/ai/usage by_provider gains unpriced_jobs so New API runs on unpriced models show 無法預估 instead of US$0.00.
storage: No change to stored keys or provider settings. New: ai_defaults and last_test per provider in the service settings table (no key material). Last settings category and ⌘, are client preferences in the Mac app.

api: GET /api/v1/projects → items with work_count (excluding trashed), archived, color, sort_order; POST, PATCH /api/v1/projects/:id {name?, color?, archived?}, PUT /api/v1/projects/order {ids}.
DELETE /api/v1/projects/:id soft-deletes (deleted_at) and drops it from lists; POST /api/v1/projects/:id/restore for the undo toast; purge later. Works are never deleted.
GET /api/v1/works?project_id=…|unassigned=1 (unassigned = no live project; archived projects still count as membership); work items gain project_ids.
POST /api/v1/works/batch/projects {work_ids, add?: project_ids, remove?: project_ids} → per-item results like the QC-052 batch; POST /api/v1/works accepts project_ids.
GET /api/v1/projects/:id/summary → counts by status, last_updated_at, asset_count; GET /api/v1/assets?project_id=… = assets referenced by the project's live works (existing media refs).
Change events project.created/updated/deleted and work.projects_changed; contracts, api-client and agent-sdk CLI (list, create, add/remove works).

openQuestions.q: 平台預覽要留在側欄（工具）還是只從作品編輯頁進入？
openQuestions.recommendation: 留在工具，編輯頁的「預覽」也直接打開它；之後看使用頻率再決定拿掉。

openQuestions.q: 數量 0 的篩選選項：停用變淡或隱藏？
openQuestions.recommendation: 停用變淡，位置不跳。

openQuestions.q: 概覽淡字要不要保留「M 個素材」？
openQuestions.recommendation: 保留，它是「用到的素材」入口；搜尋或篩選時隱藏。

openQuestions.q: 類型與狀態能否多選？
openQuestions.recommendation: 先單選，與現況一致；多選之後再議。

openQuestions.q: 繁簡互通要用完整對照表嗎？
openQuestions.recommendation: 用 opencc-js（MIT）t2s 只在比對時轉換，前後端同一張表；記入 dependencies.md。

openQuestions.q: 命中標籤要怎麼顯示？
openQuestions.recommendation: 卡片不顯示標籤；只命中標籤時片段行寫「標籤 #…」（原型未畫）。

openQuestions.q: 側欄項目很多時？
openQuestions.recommendation: 項目區自己捲動，底欄固定；超過 12 個時「項目」標題旁出現搜尋（之後再做）。
